info.name: Koduvai Runners API
info.description:
Koduvai Runners REST API (v1). Run top-to-bottom: requests save created IDs into collection variables.

1. Import this collection and the environment file.
2. Set `adminEmail` / `adminPassword` in the environment.
3. Run **0 · Health & sign-in → Sign in** first — Postman keeps the `kr_session` cookie for the admin requests.

Money is in paise (`feeMinor: 50000` = ₹500). Errors look like `{ error: { code, message, details } }`. Full reference: docs/openapi.json.

item.name: 0 · Health & sign-in
item.description: Sign in once; the session cookie is reused by all admin requests.

request.description: Sets the httpOnly `kr_session` cookie. 8 failed attempts per email lock sign-in for 15 minutes.

item.name: 1 · Public · Membership
item.description: What the website's join form uses. No sign-in needed.

exec: if (pm.response.code < 300) { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.collectionVariables.set("planId", d.find(p => p.code === "GENERAL").id); }
if (pm.response.code < 300) { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.collectionVariables.set("freePlanId", d.find(p => p.feeMinor === 0).id); }

request.description: Returns a reference number (KR-M-YYYY-NNNNNN). 409 duplicate_application if the email/phone already has an open application. Rate limited to 5/hour per IP.

body.raw:
{
  "planId": "{{planId}}",
  "fullName": "Postman Runner",
  "email": "{{uniqueEmail}}",
  "phone": "{{uniquePhone}}",
  "city": "Koduvai",
  "experienceLevel": "Beginner (up to 5K)",
  "interests": [
    "Weekend long runs"
  ],
  "emergencyName": "Family Contact",
  "emergencyPhone": "+919123456789",
  "acceptTerms": true,
  "acceptPrivacy": true,
  "acceptDeclaration": true,
  "consentWhatsapp": false,
  "consentMarketingEmail": true
}

exec: if (pm.response.code < 300) { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.collectionVariables.set("referenceNo", d.referenceNo); }

request.description: Shows the error format: `details` maps each field to a message.

item.name: 2 · Public · Events
item.description: Event discovery and registration (separate from membership).

exec: const open = pm.response.json().data.find(e => e.registration === "open" && e.categories.length); if (open) { pm.collectionVariables.set("eventSlug", open.slug); pm.collectionVariables.set("eventId", open.id); pm.collectionVariables.set("categoryId", open.categories[0].id); }

item.name: 3 · Public · Website & payments
item.description: Content API, contact form and payment status.

item.name: 4 · Admin · Membership
item.description: Requires sign-in. Approve applications, manage plans, delete members.

exec: const a = pm.response.json().data.find(x => x.referenceNo === pm.collectionVariables.get("referenceNo")); if (a) pm.collectionVariables.set("applicationId", a.id);

request.description: Paid plans move to APPROVED (payment pending); free plans become ACTIVE. To reject: `{ decision: "reject", note: "reason" }` (note required).
feeMinor is in paise. Only affects NEW applications.

exec: const a = pm.response.json().data.find(x => x.referenceNo === pm.collectionVariables.get("deleteReferenceNo")); if (a) pm.collectionVariables.set("deleteApplicationId", a.id);

request.description: `confirm` must equal the reference number. Unpaid → permanently deleted; paid → anonymised (payments kept).

item.name: 5 · Admin · Events
item.description: Create → add distance → publish → register → manage → delete.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Postman Test Run",
  "slug": "{{adminEventSlug}}",
  "summary": "Created from the Postman collection.",
  "description": "Safe to delete.",
  "type": "CLUB_RUN",
  "startsAt": "{{eventStart}}",
  "venueName": "Temple Junction",
  "city": "Koduvai",
  "registrationEnabled": true,
  "capacity": 50,
  "waitlistEnabled": true,
  "volunteersEnabled": true
}

exec: pm.collectionVariables.set("adminEventSlug", "postman-run-" + Date.now()); const d = new Date(Date.now() + 14 * 86400000); d.setUTCHours(0, 30, 0, 0); pm.collectionVariables.set("eventStart", d.toISOString());

request.description: Other statuses: DRAFT (unpublish), COMPLETED, CANCELLED (+ reason, notifies registrants).
Free category → CONFIRMED. Paid → PENDING_PAYMENT with a paymentReference. Full → WAITLISTED (if enabled) or 409 sold_out.

item.name: Register for the paid distance (payment pending)
Start online checkout (503 while payments are disabled)

request.description: Returns 503 payments_disabled until PAYMENT_ENABLED=true. The registration stays PENDING_PAYMENT — never marked paid.
Emergency contacts/medical notes are included only for roles with registrations.restricted.

exec: const r = pm.response.json().data.find(x => x.registrationNo === pm.collectionVariables.get("adminRegistrationNo")); if (r) pm.collectionVariables.set("adminRegistrationId", r.id);

request.description: Unpaid → deleted and the place released (waitlist promoted). Paid → anonymised, payment kept.
`confirm` must equal the slug. 409 event_has_payments if any registration has been paid — cancel the event instead.

item.name: 6 · Admin · Announcements
item.description: Draft → send. Sending is done by the background worker.

request.description: {{name}} is left for the server (no Postman variable has that name) and becomes each recipient's name. Audience types: ALL_ACTIVE_MEMBERS, ALL_APPROVED_OR_ACTIVE, PLAN (+planId), EVENT_PARTICIPANTS / EVENT_VOLUNTEERS (+eventId). WhatsApp needs whatsappTemplateName.

exec: if (pm.response.code < 300) { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.collectionVariables.set("campaignId", d.id); }

request.description: Returns 202; the worker (npm run worker) dispatches it. Only opted-in recipients receive promotional messages.

exec: if (pm.response.code < 300) { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.collectionVariables.set("savedHours", d.hours ?? ""); }

item.name: Update contact settings (writes back the current value)

request.description: Groups: branding, contact, social, membership, seo. Send only the fields to change, e.g. { "hours": "Tue & Thu 5:30 am" }. This sample re-saves the current value so running the collection does not change your site.
Other kinds: applications, registrations?eventId=…, payments, contacts.
